notes.title: Forg QoL Update! + New Level
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved tutorial & tutorial prompts for better clarity.
[*] Building limit now shows max text instead of cost.
[*] Increased music volume by +5 dB.
[*] Added more tips "IT'S OVER, GOBLINS. I HAVE THE HIGH GROUND!" - CANNON
[*] Moved loading screen tips to the options tab due to faster load times.
[*] [b]Replaced icons and symbols with emojis to fix alignment issues.[/b] 🪙❤️💥💣🌑☀️
[*] Made upgrade information easier to understand, add extra information as tips.
[*] [b]Collect gold from chests.[/b]
[*] [b]Eat mushrooms to heal.[/b]
[*] Corrected next item and previous item scroll order issues.
[*] Fixed scroll UI bugs.
[*] Resolved speed line overlay bugs and made improvements.
[*] Fixed damage overlay bugs and made improvements.
[*] Adjusted barricade model ropes.
[*] Added more shake effects for interactions.
[*] Achievements now available on more levels.
[*] Removed fruit basket.
[*] All levels baked.
[*] [b]New OG Level Crystal, Very Hard+ Start with 100 gold (instead of 400) & No healing mushrooms and limited high ground for strategic placements. Big respect to you if you can beat Crystal on Night Mode.[/b]
[*] Fix place building flash.
[*] Add bomb place particles.
[*] Fix sky resources.
[*] Updated screenshots.
[*] Update GIFs.
[*] Updated trailer.

[h2]Roadmap:[/h2]
[*] Engine upgrade for better performance.
[*] Community feedback and suggestions.
[/list]
